narr: A shield of moderate to heavy rainfall, associated with the remnants of tropical cyclone Ida, moved from the DelMarVa peninsula to New England. This rainfall on top of several weeks of abnormally wet weather led to areas of small stream and urban flash flooding in Northeast Pennsylvania.
ev: Flash flooding eroded and closed Sibley Avenue.
Flash flooding led to a road collapse of South Main Street near Earth Conservancy Drive.
Cars reported to be stuck in water due to urban flash flooding near River Street and the Exit 3 off ramp of the Cross Valley Expressway.
Major flooding occurred along the Big Wapwallopen Creek resulting in road closures and evacuation of the Valley Stream Mobile Village.
Flash flooding closed PA-29 near Nanticoke.
The Sans Souci Parkway was closed near West Saint Mary's Road due to flash flooding of Solomon's Creek.
